+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Small, reproducible tests; needs numpy, no downloaded test data.
+
+Brio-Wu exercises the actual Rusanov flux but is a regression/positivity test,
+not an independent quantitative comparison against a published solution.
+"""
+import json
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+EXE = HERE / "mhd_solver"
+TESTS = HERE / "tests"
+TESTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def run(name, **config):
+    directory = TESTS / name
+    options = dict(nr=24, ntheta=6, nphi=24, rmin_au=.1, rmax_au=1.2,
+                   latmax_deg=50, radial_grid="log", start_day=0,
+                   end_day=1, snapshot_days=1, gravity_gm=0, threads=2,
+                   output_dir=directory, order=2, gamma=1.5)
+    options.update(config)
+    cfg = TESTS / f"{name}.cfg"
+    cfg.write_text("".join(f"{k}={v}\n" for k, v in options.items()))
+    subprocess.run([str(EXE), "--config", str(cfg)], check=True)
+    final = sorted(directory.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]
+    return directory, np.load(final).astype(float)
+
+
+results = {}
+directory, z = run("uniform_geometry", test_cartesian_uniform=1,
+                   end_day=.2, snapshot_days=.2)
+initial = np.load(directory / "snapshot_00000.npy")
+relative = np.max(np.abs(z-initial)/(np.abs(initial)+.01))
+assert relative < 2e-5, relative
+results["uniform_cartesian_geometry"] = {"max_relative_field_change": float(relative)}
+
+errors = []
+for nr, nt, nphi in [(24, 6, 24), (48, 10, 48), (96, 16, 96)]:
+    directory, z = run(f"cold_radial_{nr}", nr=nr, ntheta=nt, nphi=nphi,
+                       end_day=3, snapshot_days=3, br_1au_nt=0,
+                       temperature_K=1, speed_kms=400, density_1au_cm3=5)
+    r = np.load(directory / "r_au.npy").astype(float)
+    # Test the flushed interior; exclude the imposed/open radial boundary cells.
+    use = (r > .2) & (r < .65)
+    mass_ratio = z[use, 1:-1, :, 0]*z[use, 1:-1, :, 1]*r[use, None, None]**2/(5*400)
+    mass_error = float(np.mean(np.abs(mass_ratio-1)))
+    speed_error = float(np.mean(np.abs(z[use, 1:-1, :, 1]/400-1)))
+    errors.append(mass_error)
+    results[f"cold_radial_{nr}"] = dict(mean_mass_flux_relative_error=mass_error,
+                                         mean_speed_relative_error=speed_error,
+                                         **json.loads((directory/"statistics.json").read_text()))
+assert errors[2] < errors[1] < errors[0], errors
+assert errors[-1] < .05, errors
+
+# Nonlinear stream test: an explicit artificial angular speed pattern is only
+# enabled by this verification configuration, never a production default.
+directory, z = run("interacting_hydro_streams", nr=48, ntheta=6, nphi=48,
+                   end_day=6, snapshot_days=6, test_speed_perturbation=.35,
+                   br_1au_nt=0, temperature_K=2e5)
+assert np.all(np.isfinite(z)) and np.min(z[..., 0]) > 0 and np.min(z[..., 4]) > 0
+assert np.std(z[-8:, :, :, 0], axis=2).mean() > .05
+assert np.max(np.abs(z[..., 3])) > 1  # Tangential deflection is evolved.
+results["interacting_hydro_streams"] = dict(
+    minimum_density_cm3=float(z[..., 0].min()),
+    maximum_azimuth_speed_kms=float(np.abs(z[..., 3]).max()),
+    **json.loads((directory/"statistics.json").read_text()))
+
+subprocess.run([str(EXE), "--test", "brio-wu", str(TESTS/"brio_wu")], check=True)
+b = np.genfromtxt(TESTS/"brio_wu/brio_wu.csv", delimiter=",", names=True)
+assert b["rho"].min() > 0 and b["p"].min() > 0
+assert np.ptp(b["By"]) > 1.5 and np.max(np.abs(b["Bx"]-.75)) < 1e-12
+results["brio_wu"] = dict(minimum_density=float(b["rho"].min()),
+                           minimum_pressure=float(b["p"].min()),
+                           maximum_normal_B_error=float(np.max(np.abs(b["Bx"]-.75))))
+(TESTS / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+"\n")
